verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets users work through natural language from their chosen LLM client, which gives an AI-native path to operating Adyen. Nothing in the evidence shows which risk-management operations that server exposes (risk profiles, custom rules, risk lists, case review), and there is no in-product natural-language interface. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP tools cover risk-management actions, a native natural-language interface in Customer Area, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
